about: Snapshot of research/niches starter costs for the money desk. Rebuild with: node packs/finance/lib/niches.js --sync

cleaning.name: House cleaning

items.item: Initial marketing (cards, door hangers, simple site)
Scheduling and invoicing software for cleaners
items.note: A free calendar plus Square invoices also works for the first clients.
Percent fees, so no low/high dollar range.

items.item: Workers compensation (only once you hire employees)
Commercial auto insurance (if you drive for work)

notYet: Don't buy a commercial backpack vacuum before your tenth recurring client.
Don't pay for scheduling software before you pass about 40 visits a month; a calendar and Square invoices work.
Don't hire a helper before your calendar is full two weeks out.

coaching.name: Coaching and consulting

items.note: judgment call: not required by law to call yourself a coach; an ICF credential is voluntary. Skip it until you have coached your first 3 people.

items.item: Business registration in your city or state
items.note: Check your city and state; costs vary.

items.item: Booking page: Calendly Free or Standard
Booking page: Google Calendar appointment schedule
items.note: Which features need a paid plan is listed on Google's comparison page; check it before you rely on payments or reminders.

items.item: Video calls: Zoom Basic or Pro
items.note: Google Meet or a phone call also works for first sessions.

notYet: Don't build a course before you've coached 3 people.
Don't pay for ads before you have a story you're allowed to share.
Don't pick a crowd wider than one kind of person and one result.

detailing.name: Mobile car detailing

items.item: Pressure washer (low PSI is safer on paint)
Vacuum (wet and dry) or interior extractor
Water tank (50 to 100 gallons) and generator for sites without hookups
Chemicals, towels and small supplies (starter stock)
Garage keepers liability (covers customer cars in your care)

notYet: Don't buy a water tank and generator rig before your tenth paying driveway client; use the client's water and power.
Don't sell ceramic coatings before you have practiced paint correction on your own cars.
Don't buy a van or trailer before your weekdays are booked.

frontdesk.name: Front desk for home service contractors

items.item: Nothing required to start: the missed-call audit, scripts and booking flow are made with this pack, and the client's tools run on the client's accounts
items.note: judgment call: a laptop and the phone you already own are enough. Don't buy phone software before your first yes.

items.item: Texting registration for the client's business number (A2P 10DLC), paid on the client's account through their texting provider
Professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance for a tech business (optional, recommended once you take paid clients)

notYet: Don't buy phone software before your first yes. Set it up on their account.
Don't say AI in your first message. Say you'll make sure they never miss a call.
Don't build anything custom yet. The setup is the product.

lawn.name: Lawn care and snow removal

items.item: Lawn mower (push or self-propelled to start)

items.note: One source; check current retail prices.

notYet: Don't buy a trailer before your tenth weekly customer.
Don't sell weed or insect treatments before you hold your state's applicator license.
Don't buy a zero-turn or a truck plow before the contracts that pay for it are signed.

petcare.name: Dog walking and pet sitting

items.item: Leashes, harnesses, waste bags, pet first aid kit, treats
items.note: StartCosts dog-walking and pet-sitting hub pages show no fixed publish date (their page date updates daily).
StartCosts dog-walking and pet-sitting hub pages show no fixed publish date (their page date updates daily).

items.item: Pet first aid and CPR course (optional)
items.note: Only one source checked; the Red Cross course page did not show a price in its page text.
StartCosts dog-walking and pet-sitting hub pages show no fixed publish date (their page date updates daily).

items.item: Rover profile review fee (if you list on Rover)
Pet care liability insurance with bonding
items.note: StartCosts dog-walking and pet-sitting hub pages show no fixed publish date (their page date updates daily).

items.item: Scheduling, GPS walk tracking and invoicing app

notYet: Don't pay for scheduling software before your tenth regular client; free tiers cover a solo walker.
Don't board dogs in your home before you check state licensing, zoning, your lease and HOA rules.
Don't take group walks in city parks before you check permit and group size rules.

photo.name: Photography (portraits, events, local business)

items.item: Camera body (used full-frame is common to start)
First lens (50mm or 35mm prime) and later lenses
External flash, memory cards, bag, tripod
Computer and backup drive for editing

items.note: Adobe's own price page could not be fetched; check Adobe's current plan price before quoting it.

items.item: Client gallery delivery (online galleries, print store)

items.note: Ranges here add liability and equipment together where the source lists both. The StartCosts photography hub page shows no fixed publish date (its page date updates daily).

notYet: Don't buy a backup body or extra lenses before paid shoots are on your calendar.
Don't fly a drone for pay before you hold an FAA Part 107 certificate.
Don't rent a studio before on-location sessions fill your weekends.

resale.name: Resale and flipping

items.note: judgment call: a kitchen or postal scale that reads ounces; label prices step up by weight, so guessing costs money.
judgment call: poly mailers for clothes, reused boxes for hard goods. Priority Mail Flat Rate boxes cost the flat price whatever the weight.
judgment call: start with things you already own, then buy only items you've checked in sold listings. Keep the first buys small.
Not needed for a first seller: 250 free listings a month come without a Store.

sources.publisher: eBay Seller Center, Understanding selling fees

items.note: Poshmark provides a prepaid label paid by the buyer; on other sites the seller buys the label, often at commercial prices through the platform.

notYet: Don't buy in bulk before you've flipped 10 items.
Don't list on every site at once. Start with one.
Don't hold an item past 60 days. Drop the price and move it.

social.name: Social media for restaurants and cafes

items.item: Nothing required to start: a phone you own, window light and free apps
items.note: judgment call; research/crowd.json not_yet says don't buy a camera.

items.item: Scheduling tool (the restaurant's Meta Business Suite is free; a scheduler is optional)

items.note: Canva and CapCut both have free versions; their paid prices could not be read from their own pages today, so check current rates before you buy.

items.item: Media liability or professional liability insurance
items.note: Covers claims such as using a photo or song you had no right to use; ask an agent (judgment call).

notYet: Don't sell 30 posts a month first. Start with one week they can see.
Don't buy a camera. A phone and good window light are enough.
Don't chase chains. Owner-run spots decide in one visit.

tutoring.name: Tutoring

items.item: Background check you can show parents

items.note: Official SAT practice resources from College Board are free; see builder notes.

items.item: Computer, webcam and microphone for online sessions
items.note: Only one source checked; $0 assumes you already own a computer.
The StartCosts tutoring page shows no fixed publish date (its page date updates daily).
Free video calling tools exist; paid plans are optional at the start.

notYet: Don't rent a room or a learning center before your weekly hours are full.
Don't buy a test prep curriculum before you have used the free official SAT practice with a student.
Don't pay for scheduling and billing software before your tenth weekly student.

washing.name: Pressure washing and window cleaning

items.item: Pressure washer, gas, 4 GPM or more
Surface cleaner (20 inch or larger) for flatwork
Hoses, wand, nozzles and downstream injector
Window cleaning starter kit (squeegees, scrubbers, belt bucket, ladders)
items.note: The StartCosts window cleaning page shows no fixed publish date (its page date updates daily).

items.item: Water-fed pole system (later, for high windows)
items.note: The StartCosts window cleaning page shows no fixed publish date (its page date updates daily).

items.item: Trailer or water tank for remote jobs (later)
Commercial auto (if the vehicle is used for work)
Monthly operating costs, solo window cleaner
items.note: The StartCosts window cleaning page shows no fixed publish date (its page date updates daily).

notYet: Don't buy a hot water unit or a trailer rig before your house washes book two weeks out.
Don't buy a water-fed pole before you have buildings that need the reach.
Don't take roof jobs before you have practiced soft washing on houses and have the insurance.

webdesign.name: Web design for local businesses

items.item: Nothing required to start: the mock homepages are built with the site pack and hosted free
items.note: judgment call: a laptop and a phone you already own are enough for the first clients.

items.item: Static site hosting for client sites
items.note: Each client should own their hosting account; you get access, not ownership (judgment call).

items.item: Business email on the client's domain (optional, passed through)
Technology errors and omissions (professional liability) insurance
items.note: Many solo designers start with a clear contract and add E&O once client sites take payments or bookings (judgment call; ask an agent).

items.item: A site builder plan, only when a client wants to edit the site themselves (client pays)

notYet: Don't build your own portfolio site first. The mock homepages are your portfolio.
Don't learn a new site builder before your first sale.
Don't quote custom features. Sell one clear package.
